entries.title: Scroll and Pointer Motion System
entries.why: A frontend motion reference for treating scroll, pointer response, layout morphs, and reduced-motion fallback as one interaction system instead of isolated effects.

entries.title: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
entries.format: scroll, carousel, shader, mask, and transition pattern library
entries.why: A compact reference set for modern frontend motion patterns: scroll-synced video/image cues, 3D text, draggable carousels, mask reveals, WebGL shaders, and page transitions are grouped with live demos and implementation context.
entries.reusePolicy: inspiration-only; verify individual demo licenses before code reuse

entries.title: Codrops Kinetic Typography Page Transition
entries.why: A precise reference for using type as the transition object: background letters rotate, scale, and move forward to preserve continuity between navigation states.
entries.reusePolicy: inspiration-only; source code link recorded for license review before reuse

compositions.title: Scroll-led scene progression
compositions.study: Motion communicates progress through a scene, not just decorative movement.
compositions.reuse: Use when scrolling should reveal structure, timeline, or product behavior.

compositions.title: Morphing layout state
compositions.study: Elements keep identity across states so the transition feels explainable.
compositions.reuse: Use for galleries, product explainers, and interactive visual essays.

compositions.entryTitle: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
compositions.title: Scroll-synced visual chapters
compositions.study: The collection surfaces patterns where scroll progress maps to image, video, depth, mask, and typography changes.
compositions.reuse: Use when a page needs motion to reveal structure or meaning instead of only adding polish.

compositions.entryTitle: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
compositions.title: Draggable and infinite motion modules
compositions.study: Carousel and grid demos show how repeated content can feel spatial and tactile without becoming hard to navigate.
compositions.reuse: Use for galleries, product collections, and media browsers with clear keyboard and reduced-motion alternatives.

compositions.title: Letters carry the page change
compositions.study: The transition gives typography identity across screens instead of crossfading unrelated layouts.
compositions.reuse: Use when a portfolio, editorial, or campaign microsite needs navigation to feel authored.

compositions.title: Final typographic still frame
compositions.study: The motion path resolves into a readable next screen, so the animated idea is not separate from content.
compositions.reuse: Design the destination composition first, then choreograph the transition into it.

assets.notes: Record durations, easing intent, and stagger rules rather than copying code.
assets.reuse: Use named timing tokens for repeatable interaction behavior.

assets.notes: Each motion sequence needs a meaningful static or low-motion state.
assets.reuse: Design the fallback before polishing the animated path.

assets.entryTitle: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
assets.notes: The useful asset is not copied code but named timing, trigger, scrub, and reveal rules.
assets.reuse: Record duration, trigger point, easing intent, and fallback state for each pattern.

assets.entryTitle: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
assets.notes: Scroll, drag, hover, and pointer behavior should be mapped before animation polish.
assets.reuse: Define which inputs are primary on desktop and what replaces them on touch devices.

assets.notes: The reusable idea is a staged timeline: background type gains prominence, moves, then reveals new content.
assets.reuse: Document phases, delays, and interruption rules before implementation.

assets.notes: Navigation must work without relying on rotating or zooming type.
assets.reuse: Use instant page change or subtle opacity/position changes for reduced-motion users.

motion.title: Progressive scene reveal
motion.notes: Scroll changes position, opacity, and scale in a way that maps to reading progress.
motion.fallback: Use stacked static sections when reduced motion is requested.

motion.title: Type as motion object
motion.notes: Text motion emphasizes meaning and rhythm instead of becoming a generic marquee.
motion.fallback: Keep the final typographic composition readable as a still frame.

motion.entryTitle: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
motion.title: Timed scroll cue sequence
motion.notes: Video, image, mask, and type motion can be synchronized to reading progress.
motion.fallback: Provide static section order and avoid hiding essential content behind animation.

motion.entryTitle: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
motion.title: Depth-based repeated content
motion.notes: 3D and parallax effects can imply depth while preserving active item clarity.
motion.fallback: Flatten to a standard carousel or stacked grid.

motion.title: Foregrounding background letters
motion.notes: Large letters become spatial objects that bridge old and new content.
motion.fallback: Keep a static title lockup and standard page transition.

interactions.title: Cursor proximity response
interactions.study: Pointer movement changes focus or depth while preserving target clarity.
interactions.reuse: Use only when the pointer behavior improves orientation or delight.

interactions.entryTitle: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
interactions.title: Pointer-driven spatial browsing
interactions.study: Drag interactions can turn browsing into tactile exploration when position and focus remain obvious.
interactions.reuse: Keep drag affordances visible and support non-pointer navigation.

interactions.title: Click-triggered page reveal
interactions.study: The interaction begins on item selection and makes the next screen feel connected to the chosen content.
interactions.reuse: Use for small sets of high-value destinations, not routine dense navigation.
